finding: Actual totals have two implementations; marked totals have related but different empty-value rules
proposed_resolution: One plan-item totals owner under the M2 write contract
compatibility_requirement: Preserve marked NULL versus actual zero; preserve first-write state changes
acceptance_test: Manual/CSV/Ipso and delete paths produce identical totals and correct parent versions/timestamps
resolution_summary: One intervention totals owner now serves manual/CSV writes; parent locks precede mutations/SUM; distinct marked NULL and actual zero rules retained. M2 totals, rollback and CSV regressions cover it.

finding: Edit versions and partial-save timestamps are governed by different owners
proposed_resolution: Adopt explicit semantic-edit and derived-write operations
compatibility_requirement: Retain C14 User counter and login exception; no universal automatic increment
acceptance_test: Accepted edit advances once; derived-only parent total does not stale metadata form; rollback is complete
resolution_summary: Row clocks now cover partial writes; accepted edits own tokens; total-only writes preserve metadata tokens; User, SiteSettings and staging intentionally retain separate contracts. Optional edit-helper cleanup is deferred.

finding: Parallel equation/availability/density wrappers
proposed_resolution: Share a neutral estimate operation alongside M1; leave applicability at domain boundary
compatibility_requirement: Preserve coppice and missing-height behavior and numeric rounding
acceptance_test: Same canonical measurement produces equal estimates across entry paths
resolution_summary: M1 supplies one estimate_volume_and_mass owner for both domains. Removed ignored species-name override parameters; CSV name resolution stays at its boundary. Configured-equation and CSV tests: 36 passed before/after cleanup.

finding: Coefficients and proxy maps are manually mirrored
proposed_resolution: Generate data projections from a neutral source when implementing M1; keep separate algorithms
compatibility_requirement: No change to materialized estimates or preview availability
acceptance_test: Python/JS coefficient parity and numeric tolerance including tiny and zero values
resolution_summary: Live coefficients already came from DB. Removed the unused browser default/proxy catalogue and name-based API; one-source numeric parity plus DB-to-preview/custom/proxy tests pass (14 Python, preview JS).

finding: Shared wire literals are manually copied across three runtimes
proposed_resolution: Add value parity for an explicit shared subset; optionally generate JS projections
compatibility_requirement: Keep current wire values and classic-script loading; do not translate enums
acceptance_test: Compare shared values not just named exports; verify offline shell loads

finding: Different edge parsers overlap but intentionally accept different representations

compatibility_requirement: Dirty marks and receipts stay atomic; never patch and invalidate one digest in the same response
acceptance_test: Cold reader and already-loaded SPA see consistent post-write data

finding: Scientific algorithms legitimately run on server and in offline/live UI

compatibility_requirement: Retain offline operation and existing precision/class boundaries
acceptance_test: Cross-runtime cases for height/diameter classes/basal area and unavailable values

finding: Haversine copies use radii 6378137 and 6371000
proposed_resolution: Choose the membership metric explicitly then reuse shared geometry bridge

acceptance_test: Points just inside/on/outside a sample radius and nearest-area selection

finding: Backend accepts more property aliases than desktop helper

finding: One exact Python body clone and similar low-level atomic writes

finding: Similar hashing code represents different frozen identities

finding: numero versus English number

compatibility_requirement: Preserve integer/null and all mode-specific allocation rules

finding: gruppo is a display/export grouping value

finding: data means session measurement date
